item.title: hybris-mobian Is Now Droidian
item.description:
Hello world,

as you might have noticed in the last few days, we changed the name of our GitHub organizations. And we also have a cool new website!

hybris-mobian was born with the objective to port the goodness of Mobian to Android devices.
